title: Inspect and renew the clutch plate stack
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only
excluded: Clutch boss nut removal or tightening

required_tools.name: Micrometer, flat surface plate and feeler gauges

required_parts.name: New pushrod1 bearing circlip if disassembled
Exact2026 stock friction/steel sets, spring/collars/pressure components as required

preflight: Removed engine supported and oil drained.
Clutch center nut/basket remain installed throughout.
entry_state: Removed engine supported and oil drained.
Clutch center nut/basket remain installed throughout.
exit_state: Clutch pack and cover installed; oil refill/engine commissioning remain.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm clutch-pack-only scope
steps.instruction: Start with the removed engine supported and oil drained. This operation leaves the clutch boss nut, basket and primary gears untouched. The separate boss-nut preparation conflict does not permit loosening that nut during this pack service.
verification: Oil drained; center nut/basket remain installed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove clutch cover and pressure parts
steps.instruction: Remove the clutch cover, retaining the two long and four short bolts in their diagram positions, and discard its gasket. Release the six pressure-plate bolts progressively and remove pressure plate1, clutch spring, spring retainer and pressure plate2. Retain their exact face directions.
verification: Cover and pressure components retained by position.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove plates and pushrod-end parts
steps.instruction: Remove the ball and pushrod1/bearing assembly; renew its circlip if disassembled. Lift out the alternating plates and six collars into their original stack order. Leave the center nut and sleeve installed.
verification: Ball, pushrod/bearing, six collars and17 plates accounted for.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect and measure friction plates
steps.instruction: Inspect all eight friction plates and replace the friction set for damage/wear. Measure thickness at four points on each: both friction types standard2.12–2.28mm, wear limit2.02mm. Preserve the four blue-marked type2 and four unpainted type1 identities.
verification: 32 friction thickness measurements and condition decisions recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect steel plates and spring
steps.instruction: Check all nine steel plates for damage; measure warpage on a surface plate using feeler gauges, limit0.10mm. Replace the steel set for damage/out-of-limit warpage. Inspect spring and retainer; spring free height4.59mm, minimum limit4.36mm. Replace defective items.
verification: Nine warpage results, spring height and retainer condition saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect collars and pressure parts
steps.instruction: Replace the six collars as a set for damage/pitting/wear. Replace cracked/damaged pressure plates. Inspect pushrod1, bearing and ball for damage/wear and replace defective parts; preserve the ball and bearing washer arrangement.
verification: Collars, pressure plates and release-end condition saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the exact seventeen-plate stack
steps.instruction: Oil the six collars and all plates. Starting at the clutch-boss side, follow the source diagram with alternating steels/frictions:1.0mm steel, blue friction,1.4mm steel, blue friction,1.4mm steel, plain friction,1.4mm steel, plain friction,1.4mm steel, plain friction,1.4mm steel, plain friction,1.4mm steel, blue friction,1.4mm steel, blue friction,1.0mm steel. Confirm four blue/four plain frictions and two thin/seven thick steels.
verification: 17-plate order, both end steels and all six collars verified.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Restore pushrod-end and pressure plate2
steps.instruction: If the bearing was removed from pushrod1, reinstall it with a new circlip. Oil bearing, pushrod1 and ball, then install ball, pushrod1 and pressure plate2 in the illustrated arrangement.
verification: Ball, bearing, circlip and pressure plate2 restored.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Tighten the pressure assembly
steps.instruction: Fit the spring retainer and clutch spring with their exact illustrated face directions, then pressure plate1 and six bolts. Oil bolt threads/contact faces and pressure-plate1 contact surfaces. Tighten all bolts4Nm in a crisscross pattern, then repeat10Nm in a crisscross pattern.
verification: Spring/retainer direction and six4Nm-then10Nm results recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Close the clutch cover
steps.instruction: Fit a new gasket and cover. Return its two long/four short bolts to the source positions and tighten progressively in a crisscross pattern10Nm. Record that the center nut/basket remained untouched; final oil filling and running checks belong to engine commissioning.
verification: New gasket, correct bolt lengths and10Nm closure recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow
